headline: Margin expansion across all segments lifts profit sharply
summary_short: Net revenue rose 5.0% y/y to $990.6 million on 4.4% organic growth, and operating income jumped 19.8% to $165.4 million as diluted EPS climbed to $0.70 from $0.41 a year ago.
summary_long: All three segments grew: Aerospace, Defense & Commercial Equipment led with 11.5% revenue growth, Automotive rose 3.3%, and Industrials rose 2.9%, both on content growth. Operating margin expanded to 16.7% from 14.6% on higher revenue, lower restructuring/amortization charges, and restructuring-driven cost savings, partly offset by material, logistics, and tariff inflation. Adjusted diluted EPS was $1.65. H1 free cash flow was $291.0 million (vs $202.1 million prior year). Cash fell to $403.3 million after $401.1 million used to pay down debt; long-term debt fell to $2.42 billion. No Q2 buybacks; quarterly dividend is $0.12/share. FY2026 capex guided up to approximately $125 million.

drivers.explanation: Growth was broad-based across all three segments, with operating income gains driven by higher revenue, lower restructuring and amortization charges, and cost savings from restructuring actions.

Aerospace/Defense/Commercial Equipment grew 11.5% on commercial-equipment and aerospace strength; Automotive grew 3.3% and Industrials 2.9%, both on content growth; FX added 1.1 points, disposals subtracted 0.5 points.

Favorable impact from higher revenue, a decrease in restructuring charges and amortization of intangibles, and cost savings from restructuring plans, partially offset by inflation on material and logistics costs.
Cost of revenue fell as a % of net revenue primarily on organic revenue growth, partially offset by inflation on material/logistics costs and tariffs.
EPS growth tracks the 68% net income increase against an almost flat diluted share count (146.7M vs 146.5M shares).
Cash fell as $401.1 million was used to pay down debt and $468.5 million was used in financing activities overall, driven primarily by settlement of a cash tender offer in Q2 2026.
